fusions.name: Tongue's Reach
fusions.desc: Lashes a curved blade at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. The target moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Down in One
fusions.desc: A cut that deals 20 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. It consumes every affliction on the target and adds their remaining damage to the blow. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Gathered to the Gullet
fusions.desc: Lashes a line 6 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Reed-Still
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
